items.title: WRTC 2026 rescored: MB5O takes gold after four DQs
items.blurb: The Judging Committee’s 1 September report voids the July awards. Pirate multiplier contacts and frequency-handoff identity releases got MB2M (VE3DZ/UW7LL), MB2A, and MB1I DQ’d under Rule 12.2; MB5Q fell under Rule 12.7. New order: MB5O (DJ5MW/DM5EE) 7.31M, MB4G (N6MJ/KL9A) 6.96M, MB1T (K5ZD/W2SC) 6.84M. Full PDF is linked from the WRTC site.

items.title: ARRL names 2026 Division Director and Vice Director candidates
items.blurb: Ballots this fall for contested seats; winners take office 1 January 2027. Contested Director races: Delta (K5UZ vs KM4NYI), Great Lakes (N8SY vs W8CI), Midwest (K0AIZ vs K3PA). Midwest also contests Vice Director (KO0Z vs KK0DX). Atlantic and Dakota Directors and several VDs are unopposed; Great Lakes had no VD candidates.

items.title: RI1FJZ: all Franz Josef Land border permits in hand
items.blurb: Vasily RA1ZZ: every team member now has Border Service passes for the restricted FJL zone — paperwork that blocks any sail without them. Gear packed, antennas stowed, Apostol Andrey ready to depart Murmansk. Planned on-air 9–25 September with up to seven radios, EME, LEO, and QO-100. No 6 m in Russia.

items.title: ISS Columbus and Service Module radios power up today
items.blurb: After Monday’s power-down for the 1 September USOS EVA, Columbus radio returns about 1155Z and the Service Module at 1200Z on 2 September. Crossband repeater stays 145.990 up (PL 67) / 437.800 down when live. No school contacts on the board this week; listen for the usual ISS-FM / ISS-DATA status lines.

items.title: HP/WE9G on air from Paraiso, Panama, through 9 September
items.blurb: Rikk WE9G starts today as HP/WE9G through 9 September. Mostly FT8 (plus FT4/FT2) with some CW and SSB on 160–6 m; SO3R, two verticals and a G5RV. Club Log, QRZ, and LoTW uploads planned real-time and free. QSL via WE9G or Club Log OQRS.

items.title: 5H1RK Tanzania: SP3RK QRP digital, late December
items.blurb: Rafal SP3RK posts 5H1RK from Tanzania 23 December 2026 through 6 January 2027. Main modes FT8, FT4, and FT2 with some CW; QRP. More station detail promised before departure — put it on the winter DX calendar now.

items.title: HK0/PY8WW San Andres holiday portable starts tomorrow
items.blurb: Renato PY8WW is on San Andres (IOTA) 3–7 September as HK0/PY8WW — vacation first, radio in free time. Small beach vertical on 6/10/12/15/17/20 m, SSB/CW/digital, no fixed schedule. LoTW daily when possible, Club Log Live Stream, cards via Club Log OQRS.

items.title: VK9WX Willis Island: fresh shack pic, still on FT8 and SSB
items.blurb: Sands VK9WX sent DX-World another shack photo dated 1 September and remains active on FT8 and SSB from the BoM weather station. He still shows on the KE5EE DX nets (7163 / 14185) when duty allows. Europe continues to struggle through the JA/US wall — watch greyline.
